messages.subject: allow HTML in dataframe
parts: I updated my shiny/shiny server, and I guess in newer versions the datatables do not render HTML.  I'm having trouble toggling the dataframe setting allowHTML = true to be applied.  Any ideas?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: allow HTML in dataframe
parts:
There is no argument called `alllowHTML` in renderDataTable(). There
is only `escape = FALSE`.

BTW, we will move to the new DT package for rendering DataTables in
the future: http://rstudio.github.io/DT/ The datatable() function also
has the `escape` argument.

Regards,
Yihui
